judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the line-art icon of three staff figures (sj__stat-team.svg, alt="") at the top of the 'Total Staff - 2025' tile in the hospital statistics grid. The crop and the screenshot show a generic pictogram inside a green circle, directly above the figure 5,652 and the caption 'Total Staff - 2025' in text; the icon adds no information that the visible text does not already give, so it is decorative and a null alt that keeps it out of the accessibility tree is the correct treatment (Understanding 1.1.1, pure decoration; techniques H67 and C9). It is not a link or control. The live HTML fetched with an ordinary browser user agent has the same markup (img.stats__icon with alt="" beside the odometer number and the 'Total Staff - 2025' paragraph), and the screenshot shows the full styled layout, so the capture does not differ in a way that matters. The element meets 1.1.1, and Rampa was right to report nothing.
